name: judge-hub
command: python3 $NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT out/m16/hub.png --description "a rendered 3D game hub plaza (not blank, not an error page) built from simple stand-in shapes such as blocks, a fountain and a queue pad, with at least one simple character" --min-score 6

name: judge-podium
command: python3 $NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT out/m16/podium.png --description "a rendered 3D podium scene (not blank, not an error page) with three stepped podium blocks made of simple stand-in shapes and simple characters standing on them" --min-score 6
